notes.title: Patch 5.0-alpha
notes.content:
[b]New Gamemode: Deliverance[/b]
[i]Deliverance is a hybrid gamemode that consists of multiple rounds. At the start of each round, teams fight over a hardpoint in the center, after which point they fight to deliver a payload to the enemy base. First to 4 points wins.[/i]
[b]
New Movement Mechanic: Sprint[/b] (Activate by pressing X)
[i]Sprint is a mechanic used for traversal outside of combat. It is a blend of autorun and an MMO-style mount, with the exception that the Assault class can use it to engage. Try attacking during sprint with Assault![/i]

[list]
    [*]Added 2 new maps for Deliverance
    [*]Static morph windows are now dynamic (you morph as soon as you input)
    [*]Normalized cancel, parry cancel and morph windows. They are now 87% of windup.
    [*]Parry recovery reduced by 50ms
    [*]Added new dash sound effect
    [*] Bunch of animation tweaks, ranges of attacks are now more normalized, underhands are more diagonal
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 4.0-alpha
notes.content:
We found ourselves some time to focus on the health of the game's foundations so even though this update does include a few new features and major overhauls to the combat, the focus of this update is on improving netcode, game stability and improving the health of our foundations moving forward.

[b]Codebase Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Weapon tracing has been reworked completely
[quote]Previously the server would perform all the weapon tracing. We got the alignment of the client-side tracers and server-side tracers really close but due to various factors like our loose turncaps, lack of swing compensation and the way we have our movement set up would still result in the weapon phasing through enemies without damaging them.
We converted our weapon tracing to a new model where the client does the tracing, suggests weapon hits to the server and the server then validates if it's valid which has significantly reduced phasing.
The server still performs weapon tracing but the server-side tracers can only be parried and they cannot deal damage.[/quote]
[*]Player bubble behavior has been reworked
[quote]Previously the player bubble was a strict capsule that you could not pass. Now we have two bubbles, one is smaller which has that behavior that you understand and now we have another bubble around that which is bigger and is "softer". You don't get caught on this bubble as much but rather slide around it, even if you walk directly into it.
This results in far fewer network movement corrections and a more fluid feeling of movement when colliding with other players.[/quote]
[*]Refactored parts of the rollback system to significantly reduce the instances of "red parries" (should happen very rarely now if you are under 100ping)
[*]Server tickrate has been increased to 120 tick
[*]Windup animation playback has been refactored to account for the new weapon tracing models
[*]Refactored how we determine server time and ping (ping values and other ping sensitive timings are more consistent now)[/list]

[b]New Stuff[/b]
[list]
[*]Implemented chase mechanic
[*]Implemented dash, bound to LSHIFT by default
[*]Implemented "Camera Forward Parry", a volume that can trigger parries that is attached to the players camera
[*]Implemented "late combo" inputs. Allowing you to combo right after you enter recovery.
[*]Implemented a UI indicator for various combat states such as "Parried" or "Riposte"
[*]Implemented a reticle UI indicator for parry window and parry recovery
[*]Implemented "Forward Tracing"
[*]Greatsword and Zweihander animations have been overhauled[/list]


[b]Combat Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Parried lockout decreased from 900ms to 600ms
[*]Deflected lockout increased from 900ms to 1000ms
[*]Adjusted where release ends, should now end on your screen instead of off-screen. (this will take time to get used to, dont over drag!)
[*]Removed combo morphs
[*]You can no longer morph during a counter
[*]Riposte and Counter window increased from 250ms to 400ms
[*]Ripostes no longer give invincibility
[*]Ripostes now reduce damage by 50% from attacks that happen on the riposter's screen
[*]Ripostes and counters now have unflinching
[*]Hitting a frontliner while they are unflinching will hitstop your attack
[*]Morphs from neutrals are now weaker
[*]Morphs from ripostes are now stronger
[*]Exhausted duration reduced from 8s to 6s
[*]Getting hit while exhausted reduces its duration by 1s
[*]Crouching and jumping no longer cost stamina
[*]Increased stamina on hit from 5 to 10
[*]Stamina drain increased across the board
[*]Cancel cost reduced to 5 stamina
[*]Turncaps tightened by about 10%
[*]Greatsword range increased
[*]Adjusted the player hitboxes to be more forgiving for the attacker
[*]Initial movement speed increased[/list]


[b]Other adjustments and bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now manage & report players that have left the server
[*]Spine bending based on camera has been modified to not move the head too far from the hips
[*]Adjusted the weapon tracers to not be too close to the base of the weapon (reduces "handle hits")
[*]Parry animations are now more reflective of the actual parry window
[*]Improved the parry camera check to be more consistent
[*]Improved the animation blending of parry into windup
[*]Fixed not being able to buffer inputs after hitting world geometry
[*]Fixed not being able to morph after attempting to exhaust yourself by morphing
[*]Fixed a rare instance where you would hit someones feet and it would result in 0 damage dealt
[*]Fixed being able to be stuck in recovery if you died right after hitting world geometry
[*]Fixed rare instance of being able to hit someone through a wall
[*]Fixed crouched locomotion animations being desynced
[*]Fixed being able to jump while dead in the deathmatch gamemode
[*]Fixed successful deflects pausing stamina regen[/list]

[quote][i] [b]Additional Notes[/b]
We are only keeping the servers up for 1 week after a new update is out. We do however often host servers on our preview branch on steam when testing new changes while we develop new patches, you can gain access to the preview branch by adding this Steam Beta Code: "pleaseletmemobe"

Known issues:
A lot of stuff has changed here and under the hood so expect a few hotfixes in the coming weeks, it's near impossible for us to catch everything in-house.
We would appreciate clips of any of these happening and it would be best if we got 1-2 seconds of context before the bug happened.
[list]
[*]Phasing can still rarely happen due to problems with the rollback system
[*]There is a shiny bug where you can get hit but there are no effects shown, you only get knockback and health is decremented. 
[*]Occasionally after dashing you might get what we call "the curse" where you are constantly rubber banding
[*]You can, in some instances, hit world geometry and a player at almost the same time and you end up hitting both.
[*]If you can reproduce animation jank that would be appreciated, in particular with zweihander.
[*]There is a scenario after a certain string of inputs, you are able to lock yourself out of inputting attacks.
[*]Zweihander animations are still a little fresh, expect some animation jank
[*]Parry ends flinch prematurely[/list][/i][/quote]

notes.title: Patch 3.0-alpha
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new map with an art pass called Atlas
[*] Added new character model
[*] Added new weapon model for Greatsword
[*] Added Zweihander as a playable weapon
[*] Added Assault class
[*] Added player character outlines
[/list]

[b]Combat Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Movement has been completely overhauled
[*] Riposte mechanic has been redesigned: Now gives you invincibility and unflinching but only for one hit.
[*] Ripostes now have +50ms release
[*] Parry window reduced from 350ms to 325ms
[*] Parry recovery increased from 350ms to 375ms
[*] Stamina on hit reduced from 10 to 5
[*] Increased stamina on deflect from 10 to 25
[*] Removed the "360°" deflect, meaning you now can't "back deflect"
[*] You can no longer combo on miss
[*] You can now combo while exhausted
[*] Missing now adds 1s to your exhaustion duration
[*] Missing now stops active health & stamina regeneration
[*] Neutral windup now stops active health & stamina regeneration
[*] Morphing now stops active health & stamina regeneration
[*] Parry lockout now stops active health & stamina regeneration 
[*] Disabled release curves
[*] Flinch lockout increased by 100ms
[*] Stun now ends whenever you get flinched
[*] You can now parry cancel while exhausted (defaults to deflect cancel)
[*] You can now parry cancel even with 1 stamina (but it will exhaust you)
[*] Increased player bubble size by 5%
[*] Increased turncaps by ~25%
[*] Benefits of hitting an enemy no longer apply when hitting a teammate
[*] Reduced cancel cost from 15 to 5
[*] Increased parry lockout from 800ms to 900ms
[/list]

[b]Improvements & Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved how the game replicates where a player is looking, resulting in much clearer swing manipulation
[*] Server browser got a facelift
[*] Animations now lower their framerate based on distance
[*] Fixed an issue where the entire chest of the player character was being counted as a headshot (lmao)
[*] Fixed an issue where your parry input could get consumed if you input it at the tail end of parry recovery
[*] Fixed an issue where combo morphs did not have a static timing
[*] Fixed an issue where player character nameplates were not showing up while spectating
[*] Fixed an issue where if you late parry, the game would sometimes perform a parry into parry
[*] Fixed an issue where turncap would persist if you died mid swing
[*] Fixed an issue where damage & stamina invincibility would not apply during the PreRound phase in LTS
[*] Removed a delay preventing you from opening the chat window repeatedly
[*] Fixed an issue where mouse cursor would not show sometimes while on the team select screen
[*] Fixed an issue where if you input fast enough, you could effectively parry-into-parry without a second parry
[/list]

[b]Notes & Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] There will likely be a smaller update in the coming days with a new character model for the assault class
[*] Zweihander left stab morphs look kinda strange in first person
[*] LTS Killzone has some visual issues
[*] Player outlines have some issues with weapon outlines
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.0-alpha
notes.content:
[b]Combat 2.0[/b]
• Renamed Feints to Cancels
[i]This distinguishes between simply canceling an attack and using the act of canceling an attack as an offensive tool, which is no longer possible
Also makes more sense when onboarding new players to say “press Q during windup to cancel your attack”[/i]

• Canceling attacks now immediately begins cancel recovery as opposed to the old "Static Feint" system
[i]Removes the ability for cancels to be self-punished as a result of total cancel downtime being 300ms longer than the new total parry/deflect time
Having this wide a gap between weapon windups and feint punish time prevents jailing someone with cancels[/i]

• Parry window decreased from 400ms to 350ms
[i]This allows us to bring down release so that late windup does not cause our swings to look incredibly floaty[/i]

• Parry recovery decreased from 650ms to 350ms
[i]This means now cancels are unable to be self-punished, but more importantly, the game can remain fast without fear of introducing true combos[/i]

• Decreased strike release by 75ms and stab release by 50ms
[i]This change restores the feeling of release to how it felt prior to late windup, but now in a world where swing manip is not penalized[/i]

• Neutral windups increased by 50ms
[i]Avoids the phenomenon of looking at someone, turning away for a brief period, and turning back just to find you were already hit, which can be suffocating to swapping and 1vX
Also enables the morph window to feel better for both the attacker and defender by providing a larger morph input window and simultaneously increasing the time between the latest time a morph could occur and the earliest time the initial attack could’ve dealt damage[/i]

• Combo windups decreased by 100ms
[i]Now that total parry/deflect time is so short, we can revert combo windups to their former (fast) glory without causing true combos
These will feel even faster thanks to late windup[/i]

• Increased feint recovery by 25ms

[b]Exhausted 2.0[/b]
• You can now riposte while exhausted
• You can now cancel and morph from a riposte while exhausted
• Increased exhausted from 6s to 8s
• Decreased how much exhausted duration would be shortened after a deflect from 2s to 1s
• Exhausted timer now pauses while in windup, release or stunned
• Landing a hit while exhausted shorten the exhausted duration by 1s
• Exhausted windups are no longer slower
• Exhausted turncaps are no longer tighter
• Removed exhausted lockout (a lockout that prevented you from attacking after deflecting someone while exhausted)
• Removed exhausted flinch value (now just uses normal flinch)
• Removed exhausted parry lockout value (now just uses normal parry lockout)
• Removed exhausted animations
[i]These changes will have the effect of exhaustion provoking more interesting and less confusing interactions than before as well as being less of a death sentence.[/i]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
• Combo windups no longer use the windup value of the attack comboed out of but rather the attack being comboed into
• Morph window has been changed to no longer be a percentage of windup but rather Windup • 300ms
• Riposte input window increased from 150ms to 400ms
• Input buffering windows have been made significantly shorter across the board
• Added "local admin", allowing servers to give certain steamID's admin privileges
• Added local server banning
• Added local server muting
• Tuned the exhausted sound effect to be quieter
• Removed the tutorial video (proper tutorial coming soon)

notes.title: Patch 1.2-alpha
notes.content:
- Reduced the amount you can look down by 10°

- Reduced how much the third person player model can look down
Note: The goal is to remedy the issue where overhead animations can clip with your target's camera, resulting in problematic accels

- Tuned the feint recovery animation
Note: The goal is to give the recovery animation a more immediate "tell" when the feint happens

- Tuned the first person player model to better match where tracers are
Note: This should slightly help with phasing

- Fixed game versioning
Note: This will only come into effect after the next patch comes out since the current clients have broken versioning

- Deathmatch healing zone delay reduced from 1.5s to 1.0s

- Increased the 2 input deep buffering window for parry into parry from 100ms to 150ms

notes.title: Patch 1.1-Alpha
notes.content:
- Attacks while exhausted now have 50% tighter turncap

- Bubble size increased
Note: This is an experimental fix while we spend more time tuning
animations and movement.

- Stamina on hit increased to 10

- Exhausted attacks have been tuned to reduce egregious backswing scenarios

- Stabs tuned to be slightly more reactable

- LTS_Storm has received a significant update

- Feint recovery system has been temporarily disabled for a hardcoded 450ms feint recovery time

- Added a skip button to the tutorial video

- Added a team auto-select

- Added "service chat messages" like a message when a player joins

- Added "Hide Empty" option to server browser

- Added "Watch Tutorial" in the main menu

- Removed the comp/casual player segregation

- Fixed an issue where chat messages would make your mouse cursor disappear

- Fixed character nameplates disappearing for enemies while dead

- Fixed character ragdolls sometimes falling through the world, only leaving a floating hand

- Fixed chat messages not wrapping when the message exceeds the chat window

- Fixed servers not being joinable when they are almost full

- Fixed issue where you could respawn at will in deathmatch

- Fixed a small hitch in the main menu background sequence

- Fixed flinch sometimes not stopping client-side animations

- Removed redundant language options

- Removed respawn SFX

- Font changes for character nameplates, scoreboard & chat
